title: BenchReplayRow
description: One row of bench/results/replay/<role>/replay.csv: the outcome of one Tier 1 replay or Tier 2 regeneration of a recorded AI-arm run (RQ6, 04 §7 "Replay"). Written by bench replay, committed to git and released with the paper; evaluation-only.

tier.description: 1 = replay of the recorded receipt (Tier 1); 2 = regeneration of the proposals (Tier 2), 04 §7 "Replay".

run_id.description: The kept record run under <runs root>/bench-ai/ (bench ai_arms) that was replayed or regenerated.

method.description: Method id from the experiment YAML, as in bench_result.method.

seed.description: The AI seed of the run, as in bench_result.seed.

experiments.description: Ids of the experiments whose manifest lists the run, sorted, ;-joined in the CSV.

exit_code.description: Tier 1: the exit code of veyltrace replay (ReplayExit 0-6, 10 §3.9), read from its report; null when reason is set, and for Tier 2.

reason.description: Why there is no exit code or regeneration: no_receipt (an ok run without receipt.json), no_report (the command wrote no report: a usage error or crash), timeout (killed at the bench timeout), regen_failed (Tier 2: the regenerated run is not ok or has another run id); null otherwise.

verdict_hash.description: The recorded verdict_hash: the receipt's (Tier 1) or the kept verdict's (Tier 2).

verdict_hash_replayed.description: The recomputed verdict_hash: the report's verdict_hash.actual (Tier 1) or the regenerated verdict's (Tier 2); null when none was computed.

trace_match.description: Tier 1: the report's agent_trace_head expected equals actual; null when not compared.

card_match.description: Tier 1: the report's card_hash expected equals actual; null when not compared.

proposals_match.description: Tier 2: the SHA-256 of the regenerated proposals.json equals the kept run's (byte-identical, 04 §7); null for Tier 1 and when not regenerated.

first_divergence.description: Tier 1: the report's first_divergence (the first diverging artefact, 10 §3.9 R8); null when none.

env_drift.description: Tier 1: the report's env_drift entries in report order, ;-joined in the CSV; empty cell = no drift.
